svg.title: Allocate Capital Before the First Closing
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate Capital Before the First Closing; subtitle: Four buckets compare $15,000, $50,000, and $100,000 startup plans.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values encode the illustrative $50,000 allocation. Each stage also states its corresponding $15,000 and $100,000 allocation. These are startup funding plans, not additional revenue scenarios or assumed annual expense budgets.; caption: Low plan: $4,000 + $5,000 + $3,000 + $3,000 = $15,000. Middle plan: $12,000 + $16,000 + $10,000 + $12,000 = $50,000. High plan: $24,000 + $32,000 + $20,000 + $24,000 = $100,000.; stages: label: Business readiness and systems; value: $12,000 middle-plan allocation for setup and operating systems; numeric value: 12000.0; detail: Low: $4,000; middle: $12,000; high: $24,000. Fund licensing-related setup, insurance deposits, devices, CRM, docket access, document storage, and transaction checklist configuration.; label: Origination and relationship development; value: $16,000 middle-plan allocation for measurable pipeline creation; numeric value: 16000.0; detail: Low: $5,000; middle: $16,000; high: $32,000. Fund targeted outreach, attorney relationship work, property-market materials, and source attribution without purchasing prohibited referrals.; label: Delivery mobilization; value: $10,000 middle-plan allocation for contracted execution capacity; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Low: $3,000; middle: $10,000; high: $20,000. Fund contractor onboarding, field coordination, transaction setup, and operator-paid listing preparation under documented scopes.; label: Liquidity reserve; value: $12,000 middle-plan allocation for delays and operating continuity; numeric value: 12000.0; detail: Low: $3,000; middle: $12,000; high: $24,000. Preserve cash for court delays and slow collections. With 4–18 months to a first deal, test actual burn before hiring; these reserves do not establish complete runway.
